messages.english: Open evidence tools for your saved country.
messages.translation: Pfula switirhisiwa swa vumbhoni swa tiko leri u ri hlayiseke.
Kambisisa vumbhoni bya tiko leri u ri hlayiseke

messages.english: Crop planner → Site country and region → Review country evidence
messages.translation: Xikunguhati xa swibyariwa → Tiko na xifundzha xa ndhawu → Kambisisa vumbhoni bya tiko

messages.english: Use the country you saved for this site to open its existing evidence dossier. Countries without a dossier show general reference tools. Opening the link does not save country details, approve an agricultural region or enable local crop advice.
messages.translation: Tirhisa tiko leri u ri hlayiseke eka ndhawu leyi ku pfula fayili ya rona ya vumbhoni leyi se yi nga kona. Matiko lama nga riki na fayili ya vumbhoni ma komba switirhisiwa swa vuxokoxoko swo tirhisiwa hi ku angarhela. Ku pfula xihlanganisi a swi hlayisi vuxokoxoko bya tiko, a swi pasisi xifundzha xa vurimi naswona a swi pfuli switsundzuxo swa swibyariwa swa ndhawu yoleyo.
